helpers.name: add_flow

parameters.name: theme_ids
parameters.description: IDs of the theme(s) this flow belongs to — at least one. Every flow belongs to a theme; pick from get_all_themes() or add_theme() first.

helpers.purpose: Add a project flow (evolving behaviour/architecture description) linked to at least one theme. theme_ids is required: a flow never exists without a theme.
helpers.error_handling: Returns error if theme_ids is empty or names a theme that does not exist; nothing is written in that case.
return_statements: LINK THE FLOW: link it to the milestone that introduced it via add_milestone_flows([[milestone_id, flow_id]]), and include it in the flow_ids of the tasks that build it.
FILES: files implementing this flow get it via flow_ids at reserve_file/reserve_files time, or add_file_flows for files that already exist.
Call add_note(note_type='evolution', reference_table='flows', reference_id=<flow_id>) describing the new behaviour this flow captures.
implementation_notes: Returns: {success, id, theme_ids}
Inserts the flow and its flow_themes rows in one transaction; themes validated first

SUCCESS LOGIC: Creates audit note for deletion
